acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc:
When Pete turned 18, his dad took him on a drive to reveal a family secret he was finally old enough to know.
You can hear more about Peter’s family on The Documentary Podcast.

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc:
Sometimes, a lore drop comes when you least expect it. That happened to Jake Cornell and his grandmother. Producer Aviva DeKornfeld talked to Jake about it.
Jake told a version of this story onstage. Find more of his work at @jakewcornell on Instagram.
acts.title: Save the Drama for your Grandmama

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc:
Ben Austen had a kind of new lore drop happen to him recently. But it was not the clarifying kind of lore drop, where everything suddenly makes sense — it was kind of the opposite.
Ben is the author of Correction: Parole, Prison, and the Possibility of Change.
acts.title: Bully Pulpit
